revisions.name: logo
revisions.prompt:
Edit this exact Korean fantasy game logo. Keep the existing cream top line "운빨냥국", gold bottom line "배틀", crown, paw, stars, coral ribbon accents and dark teal backing. Make ONLY these corrections:
1) The LAST syllable "틀" in bottom word "배틀" must be a completely NORMAL, unmodified, upright Korean sans-serif glyph. Use the plain standard Pretendard ExtraBold glyph for "틀": the correct recognizable stacked syllable ㅌ + ㅡ + ㄹ. No speed stripes, no stretching horizontal strokes, no stylized missing strokes, no custom decorative letter construction. It must instantly read exactly "틀", not "들", "튤" or an abstract emblem. Make it gold like "배", align to same baseline and weight. Legibility is more important than retaining the original stylization. Keep overall two-line text "운빨냥국" / "배틀" accurate.
2) REMOVE the existing malformed perspective dice completely. Replace with EXACTLY TWO separate perfectly SQUARE FRONT-FACING WHITE DICE FACES, side by side at lower right of lettering. Equal width and height, parallel horizontal/vertical edges, small rounded corners allowed, dark thin border. Do NOT use perspective, rotation, a trapezoid, a diamond, a cube showing multiple faces, or fused overlapping shapes. They are two clean flat square dice. Left die has EXACTLY THREE evenly spaced black circular pips in a diagonal. Right die has EXACTLY FOUR black circular pips, one in each corner. Clear visible gap between the two square dice. Same scale, no dots on side faces. No other dice anywhere.
Keep the rest of logo design and colors. Remove all outside background to genuine alpha transparency. No sky, no characters, no extra text, no TOUCH TO START, no glow, no grain/noise. Full complete logo silhouette with transparent margin. Clean sharp vector-like artwork. Inspect the requested text and dice geometry carefully.
